title: Yellow Tangy Korean Noodles Kalguksu
description: A tangy and juicy Korean noodle dish featuring a sweet and spicy sauce, made with white wine and candy, perfect for a monsoon day. This gluten-free-friendly recipe is a twist on traditional kalguksu noodles.

ingredients.name: candy
ingredients.notes: such as Korean chili flakes infused sugar

instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil and cook the kalguksu noodles according to the package instructions.
In a blender or food processor, combine the white wine, candy, gochujang, soy sauce, garlic, and ginger, and blend until smooth.
In a large skillet, heat the blended sauce over medium heat and bring to a simmer.
Add the cooked noodles to the skillet and toss to coat with the sauce.
Cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, until the noodles are well coated and the sauce has thickened.
Stir in the green onions and cook for 1 minute.
Serve the noodles hot, garnished with additional green onions if desired.
Let the dish cool for a few minutes before serving to allow the flavors to meld together.
